Inspect or control the persistent per-user daemon

Usage: mj daemon [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  endpoint  Print the local authenticated control endpoint for an SSH client
  afk       Set or show whether the operator is away
  status    Show daemon PID, version, start time, and client count
  stop      Stop the daemon. A graceful stop leaves detached workers running unless `--suspend-sessions` suspends them first
  restart   Gracefully replace the daemon with this Mjolnir build
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -i, --instance <NAME>  Isolate configuration, database, daemon, and logs under `instances/<name>`. This is a different `mj` world, not a harness profile; explicit `MJ_CONFIG_DIR`/`MJ_DATA_DIR` still take precedence [env: MJ_INSTANCE=]
      --no-splash        Start the dashboard without the animated startup splash, for example over a slow remote connection [env: MJ_NO_SPLASH=]
  -h, --help             Print help
